subject: Meteorology
title: Layers of the Atmosphere
description: A quick win: understand Layers of the Atmosphere.

hook.text: The atmosphere has five main layers—each with distinct temperature behavior and character.

buildup.text: The troposphere (0–12 km) holds 80% of the air and all our weather—temperature drops with altitude here.

discovery.text: The stratosphere (12–50 km) contains the ozone layer—and temperature actually increases with height.

twist.text: The mesosphere is where meteors burn up—it's also the coldest layer, dropping to −90°C.

climax.text: The thermosphere above can reach 2,000°C—but so few molecules exist that it wouldn't feel hot.

punchline.text: Five layers, five personalities—all above your head.

quiz.question: Which atmospheric layer contains all our weather?
